subject.title: Feature: Auto session split when approaching context window limit

question: Should OpenClaw add token/context-pressure automatic session rollover, and what canonical config shape plus durable handoff contract should it use?
rationale: The missing capability is clear, but the fix defines public session lifecycle config and behavior that must coexist with compaction, reset policy, memory flush, delivery identity, and privacy/security rules.

options.title: Add opt-in core context rollover
options.body: Define a disabled-by-default session rollover policy with thresholds, handoff artifacts, idempotent backing-session rotation, delivery preservation, docs, and focused tests.

options.title: Fold into broader lifecycle design
options.body: Keep this issue as the token-pressure requirement and implement it only alongside the adjacent TTL/max-turn session rotation design.

options.title: Defer automatic rollover
options.body: Document compaction, memoryFlush, transcript rotation, and manual or scheduled reset mitigations while avoiding new core session lifecycle config for now.

recommendation.title: Add opt-in core context rollover
recommendation.body: Define a disabled-by-default session rollover policy with thresholds, handoff artifacts, idempotent backing-session rotation, delivery preservation, docs, and focused tests.

likelyOwner.reason: The decision spans current session schema, auto-reply session admission, and compaction behavior where steipete has the strongest current-source and feature-history signal.
